Package mpl1.thelastguest.controller

Class SelectCharacterController

java.lang.Object
mpl1.thelastguest.controller.SelectCharacterController
public class SelectCharacterController extends Object
Controller for display select character menu (start game)

This class interact with this view SelectCharacterScreen and the principal game Main Its objective is to trigger the action leading to select character.
